item.title: Bushfire Spreading on Multiple Fronts, Residents Urged to Monitor Conditions
item.description:
Bushfire Spreading on Multiple Fronts, Residents Urged to Monitor Conditions

A fire has started in the area and is currently classified as a bushfire that is spreading on multiple fronts. The latest information was recorded on 05/10/2026 at 16:00 hours.

🔥 Overview

  • ALERT LEVEL: Advice – a fire has started in the area.
  • FIRE TYPE: Bushfire.
  • Information current as at: 05/10/2026 16:00 hours.

📍 Current Status

  • STATUS: GOING – a fire which is spreading on one or more fronts.
  • Effective containment strategies are not in place for the entire perimeter.

⚠️ Risks to People

  • Smoke from this fire may affect visibility.
  • Active fire may occur close to the roadside.
  • Firefighting crews may be working close to the roadside.

🗒️ What to Do

  • Monitor the situation for changes.
  • Conditions may change; monitor conditions in your area.
  • Stay informed until threat is reduced.
